reviews.title: CHAI
reviews.body:
EDITED FROM 4 STARS

When I came across this AI platform, it was a fantastic way to role-play and indulge in story-like scenarios. I was more than willing to watch ads to continue chatting, and was extremely pleased with the content.

I came across the complaints of the developers being money hungry. Cautious, I avoided updates. I was an everyday user until today, when it required me to update in order to access the app.

Every update stating “Bug fixes & improvements” is MISLEADING. The app has become greedy for money like any other AI interaction platform has. It is now necessary to pay for messaging after a certain point.

Perhaps it is a money issue for the developers, but it seems beyond unreasonable to willingly choose to irritate countless of content, happy users. Users were pleased with the lack of payment required because any other AI platform I’ve come across requires it. That is what made CHAI unique and worthwhile—not to mention worth 5 Stars. Instead of keeping those happy users, they decided to be exactly the app everyone despises.

Your chats will disappear after 30 days, regardless, so if you’re out of messages, you’re out of luck.

Truly has turned into a disappointment.

Do not get me wrong, it is not completely and utterly terrible, but the idea of the “pieces” is disappointing in comparison to what we once had. Considering the downfall, I only expect it to worsen. It is still a really great platform for unfiltered storylines, so that every response is realistic and not to bot-like.

- everyday CHAI user,

reviews.title: Latest update made chats worse
reviews.body:
I used to rate this app 5 stars, but after the latest update, I can’t anymore.
The quality of chats has noticeably gotten worse. Once the “character’s memory is full” notification appears, the responses start to feel significantly weaker, even after increasing the memory limit. Characters seem to lose track of context more easily, their replies become more generic and unnatural, and the alternative responses often feel less logical and less consistent with the character’s previous personality and writing style.

I regularly have long-running roleplay chats that reach 50K–100K of memory usage. For me, 20K is often only the beginning of a story, not the end of it. Characters may still remember the general plot, but they start losing smaller details, previous conversations, personality consistency, and relationship development that make a long story feel coherent. A 20K memory limit simply isn’t enough for long-form roleplay.

The new Memory & Pieces system is also extremely confusing. It’s unclear what exactly is being consumed, when Pieces are actually required, why the model can sometimes continue working after an “insufficient Pieces” warning, and how increasing the memory limit actually affects response quality.

If this system is still being tested, please make it an optional beta feature and allow users to switch back to the previous system. Right now, the update feels less like an improvement and more like a downgrade in both chat quality and overall predictability.

Third, why do the chats disappear? What is the reason for that? If I have a conversation I enjoyed or something I want to look back on, I should be able to access it. Having chats disappear makes the app feel unreliable.

Overall, I genuinely used to enjoy this app now it’s just greed🙄

All in all, I love the app but I’m really annoyed about the way they’re trying to make me pay or spend hours watching ads to use it. I’m looking into other apps.
